integrity: Analytic proof only; no numerical experiment used as an infinite-dimensional proof. No independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Real smooth Banach spaces and nonempty closed convex Chebyshev sets only; nonsmooth and nonconvex settings not treated. The theorem follows from standard projection variational inequalities and may have an equivalent earlier formulation not identified by the comparison.
title: Residual idempotence characterizes convex cones in smooth Banach spaces
